**Expected behaviour**
What you expected instead, and why - e.g. "the original BBC Micro game does X" (see [reference-sources.md](https://github.com/aphawkins/the-sharp-kind/blob/main/docs/reference-sources.md) if you're citing the original).

**Steps to reproduce**
1. ...
2. ...

**Logs**
Relevant lines from the log file (`%AppData%\The Sharp Kind\logs` on Windows, `~/.config/The Sharp Kind/logs` elsewhere), if any.

**Config**
Anything unusual in your `elite.sharp` / `stuntcarracer.sharp` (rendition, backend, window scale, etc.), if relevant.
